english.note: Use 門口 as the everyday word for the doorway or entrance of a building.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a doorway or entrance.
This is the all-purpose casual choice for the area just outside a house entrance, including an ordinary porch.
Use this for a physical doorway or gateway, especially when referring to the area at or around it.
Use 門口 for the physical doorway or area immediately outside a home, shop, or building rather than a formal entrance point.
Use this for a doorway or entrance opening in a wall or fence rather than for the barrier itself.

examples.english: The building's entry is on the right.

examples.english: We’re sitting on the porch, enjoying the breeze while we wait for you to come back.
